## Intention

Input files: `03_dat_aug.tsv`, `03_dat_long.tsv`

To model the difference in gene expressions between patient and control and see if it is statistically significant in different tissue types and lesions.

## Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("broom")
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_aug <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))
data_long <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_long.tsv"))
```

## Functions

Creating a function that models our data and finds if differences between patient and control are statistically significant.

```{r}
stat_model <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    select(Sample, Group, Gene, Expression) |> 
    group_by(Gene) |> 
    nest() |> 
    mutate(model_object = map(.x = data,
                              .f = ~ lm(Expression ~ Group, data = .x)),
           model_object_tidy = map(.x = model_object,
                                   .f = ~ tidy(
                                     .x, 
                                     conf.int = TRUE, 
                                     conf.level = 0.95))) |>
    unnest(cols = model_object_tidy) |> 
    filter(term == "GroupPatient") |> 
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value)) |> 
    select(-data, -model_object, -term) |> 
    mutate(Significance = case_when(p_adj > 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
                                    p_adj <= 0.05 ~ "Significant")) |> 
    relocate(Gene, estimate, p.value, p_adj, Significance) |> 
    arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
}
```

Pie chart function.

```{r}
pie_maker <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(
    x = "",
    y = n,
    fill = Significance)) +
    geom_bar(
      alpha = 0.5,
      stat = "identity",
      width=1, 
      color="white") +
    coord_polar("y",
                start = 0) +
    theme_void()
}
```

## Analysis

#### Peritoneal lesions

Selecting data regarding peritoneal lesions.

```{r}
peri_lesion_long <- data_long |> 
  filter(Lesion_type == "Peritoneal lesion" |
           (Group == "Control" & Tissue == "Peritoneum")) |> 
  select(-Lesion_type,-Tissue, -Plot_group)
peri_lesion_long

```

Finding the difference between gene expression in the control group vs. the patient sub types, and using a model to find out if it is statistically significant.

```{r}
peri_lesion_model <- stat_model(peri_lesion_long)
peri_lesion_model
```

```{r}
peri_lesion_summary <- peri_lesion_model |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(Significance) |> 
  summarise(n = n())
peri_lesion_summary
```

```{r}
pie_maker(peri_lesion_summary) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant difference between control and patient",
    subtitle = "Peritoneal lesions"
  )
```
